material.content: {"text":"if you've been wondering how people spin up sub agents","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,54]}]}

{"text":"it's not a make money while you sleep open claw version","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,55]}]}

{"text":"clown or a Mac Mini to run agents","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,33]}]}

{"text":"so to put simply one agent is just Claude","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,41]}]}

{"text":"so every time you open a chat with Claude","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,41]}]}

{"text":"you can actually spin up multiple agents in one chat","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,52]}]}

{"text":"and each one is just another Claude instance","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,44]}]}

{"text":"the easiest way to spin up a sub agent","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,38]}]}

{"text":"or spin up five agents to research this","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,39]}]}

{"text":"Claude will throttle your use or you run out of tokens","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,54]}]}

{"text":"so for example let's build a research agent right now","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,53]}]}

{"text":"you can also restrict it to web search","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,38]}]}

{"text":"it's not biased to what you've already discussed","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,48]}]}

{"text":"it'll run on its own and hand you back a clean summary","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,54]}]}

{"text":"you can actually run them in different formations","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,49]}]}

{"text":"which is when they go out to research in parallel","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,49]}]}

{"text":"and then come back to synthesize all the information","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,52]}]}

{"text":"and then argue all together to get the best answer","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,50]}]}

{"text":"where you spawn a bunch of varied agents","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,40]}]}

{"text":"on the same problem and they kind of just merge","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,47]}]}

{"text":"their answers together to give you the strongest answer","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,55]}]}

{"text":"or you can even have them score each other's work","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,49]}]}

{"text":"and then keep looping it until they get it right","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,48]}]}

{"text":"and I'll send you the full guide on sub agents","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,46]}]}

{"text":"as well as how to spin up all the formations","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"C:/Users/anayk/AppData/Local/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect/7482756842486009094/92df43a041fca34183aa56ed9d814d41/font.ttf","id":"7482756842486009094"},"size":10,"range":[0,44]}]}
